name: hukuhaka-worklog
description: Maintain current project work and durable completion or closure history in a shared host-neutral worklog.

interface.shortDescription: Keep current work and decision history consistent.
interface.longDescription: Record current work in one host-neutral file, move completed or closed outcomes into durable history, and run setup, status, and archive before model invocation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $hukuhaka-worklog:worklog to record or update this project's work.
